summary: IRADIMED Corporation filed an 8-K on July 31, 2026, announcing its second-quarter 2026 financial results, including revenue of $20.5 million, GAAP diluted EPS of $0.41, and a regular quarterly dividend of $0.20 per share payable August 28, 2026. The company also reaffirmed full-year 2026 guidance. This is a routine earnings announcement and dividend declaration, not a special-situation event. No strategic changes, acquisitions, or extraordinary corporate actions are indicated. The filing is classified as 'None' under special-situations criteria.
